notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
I have been playtesting the game some and came up with a few small updates that I think will bring some quality of life changes to how it feels to fight through the hordes of enemies. 

Changes:

- Added knockback when enemies are hit.
- Reduced enemy speeds
- Visual update to health bars
- Made Archers more accurate

Thanks again for all the feedback. 

- Oak The Wise

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Minor Update today. Just fixing some bugs dealing with saving settings correctly.

notes.title: Enhance Squad Member Feature Update
notes.notes:
Hey, 

I got feedback from some users who felt that sometimes they had nothing to do if they didn't collect gold or level up their king in order to increase their max team size. In response to that I have added a new feature that allows you to increase a unit's stat (based on the leveling stat of a Squad member)

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNGZ5Zmthdmw0N2l1Y3p5N2JpZXR3bXJoaWx0dHZ1dnY4dXlqMnNhaCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/S0Hl9PFoObESxXqRvP/giphy.gif[/img]

Keep the feedback coming. Let me know if you like the new feature or if you have anything else that I can improve. 

- Oak The Wise

notes.title: Game Speed Option Added
notes.notes:
Hey, 

After looking into some more feedback. I found that some people may not always have time to sit down and play the full game. So I have added an option to speed the game up to 2.5 x speed. This (if you have the reflexes) could be a real time saver for when you want to play but are looking for a shorter season. 

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmx6dXEzMzkybDVpM214cHFzdGdsY2Y4Z2V6d2V4dzduMHp5eWNnNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ccWtkCAnUTQuXy3JYI/giphy.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy the update. Please keep providing feedback so we can work together in sculpting the direction the game is taking. 

- Oak The Wise

notes.title: Pick ups!
notes.notes:
I have been asked by multiple people to include pickups on the map. The way I went about this was to implement a drop on kill system for the enemies. Meaning when you kill an enemy there is now a chance it will drop an item that will permanently upgrade a stat for one of your units. 

On pick up the item will take a look at the "leveling stats" for all of your living units and then apply the stat increase. As mentioned it will prioritize units with matching "leveling stats", however if one is not found it will randomly assign it to one of your units. 

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMndmdnJwZng4eDE2a2lpMzkwdG56cGI0aHU4Z2V4dWZnbXI0NWh2dCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/DMIHGGayPxCB9jGbJc/giphy.gif[/img]

As per usual, please feel free to give me any feedback on the new system. 

Notes: 

The text descriptions for the new pick up are not as perfect as I would like and I will be working on fixing that in a future update. 

If you are confused about what a leveling stat is, please check out the tutorial and be sure to Middle mouse click/ press X on your units to see their unit info.

notes.title: Adding Tutorial
notes.notes:
After speaking to my testers, one thing they have been asking for is a tutorial. I have added a new button to the main menu that will take you to a quick tutorial that will walk you through a lot of what is going on in the UI. 

As I get more feedback I will continue to add to the tutorial. I hope everyone is enjoying the game. If not please let me know on the community page or through an email. 

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExczhxcTM0dWk3dHpzdzJqMHhraW9jN3U5NHpwcWxuaHoxamxrY2ZxbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/MwI8CxbJljJhSWuqBl/giphy.gif[/img]

Thanks, 
- Oak The Wise
